content.summary: To successfully install dbt Core on your operating system, you need to ensure that you have the necessary prerequisites, which include specific versions of Python and other dependencies depending on your OS.
content.explainer: When installing dbt Core, it's crucial to prepare your operating system by installing the required software components beforehand. This process varies based on the operating system you are using. For instance, if you are on CentOS, you need to install Python along with several other dependencies using the command line. The command provided, `sudo yum install redhat-rpm-config gcc libffi-devel python-devel openssl-devel`, installs essential packages that dbt Core relies on. Similarly, for MacOS, you must have Python version 3.8 or higher. You can check your current Python version by running `python --version` in the terminal. If your version is lower, you can download the appropriate version from the official Python website. Additionally, if you are using an Apple M1 chip, it's recommended to install dbt through Rosetta to ensure compatibility with certain dependencies that are designed for Intel processors. After setting up the prerequisites, you can install dbt Core by running `pip install dbt` in your terminal. This command will download and install dbt Core along with its dependencies, completing the installation process.
